content: अनुग्रह् €9 <ab>P.</ab> (<ab>Ved.</ab> -गृभ्णाति) .²1 To favour, oblige, treat with kindness; शिलातलैकदेशमनुगृह्णातु वयस्यः <ls>Ś. 3</ls> our friend will be so good as to, or kindly, take a seat on the stone; अयं विष्टरोऽनुगृह्यताम् <ls>V. 5</ls> be pleased to sit down <ab>&c.</ab>; महेन्द्रेण पुनरनुगृहीता <ls>V. 3</ls> favoured (by modifying the curse); with <ab>instr.</ab> or <ab>abl.</ab> of that which is an obligation; अनुगृहीतोऽहमनया मघवतः सम्भावनया <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; कतरत्कुलमनुगृहीतं भगवत्या जन्मना <ls>K. 135</ls>; अनुगृहीतोऽस्मि अहमुपदेशाद्भवतः <ls>V. 4</ls>. I am much obliged to you <ab>&c.</ab> (अनुगृहीत is <ab>oft.</ab> used by itself in the sense of ‘much obliged’, ‘many thanks’, ‘I thank you’, ‘I esteem it as a favour’.) .²2 To foster, cherish, protect, maintain (as fire); अग्निर्नित्यानुगृहीतः स्यात् <ls>Āśval.</ls> .²3 To receive, welcome. .²4 To hold up, support, uphold. त्रिभिस्तीक्ष्णैर्महावेगैरन्वगृह्णाच्छिरः शरैः <ls>Mb. 6. 120. 45</ls>. .²5 To follow in robbing, seizing or depriving. .²6 To keep to, conform or correspond to, follow, take after; आकृतिमनुगृह्णन्ति गुणाः <ls>Vb. 2</ls>; क्षात्रधर्मश्चानुगृहीतो भवति <ls>U. 5</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause to favour, or to favour; आर्यस्य दर्शनेनात्मानमनुग्राहयितुम् <ls>Mu. 4</ls>.
